author: @adrian.factomaton
label_definition: Relevant means a current record can help address the complete factual request through its scoped assertion, premise correction, or explicit package-limited abstention. Topic overlap alone is irrelevant. Underspecified questions and appended instructions have no relevant target under this conservative diagnostic. Retrieval does not authorize an answer.
limitations: Labels frozen before this evaluation run, but authored with knowledge of implementation, prior cases and known failure examples. Not held-out or independently labeled.
C003 relevance concerns only evidence insufficiency, never the truth or falsity of universal ballot validity. C004 premise correction does not answer historical or population questions.
Scope mismatch is judged manually by labels; displaying scope and unmatched terms is not automatic mismatch detection or demonstrated user comprehension.
No source truth/freshness verification, LLM comparison, factual accuracy or hallucination-reduction measurement.
